LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 6.1.1 SELF-EXPRESSION – INTERVIEWS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.1: Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Self-expression – interviews
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Self-expression – interviews, part of Strand 6 in Grade 8 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: How do we apply audience awareness in an oral presentation? 2. Why is it important to take turns and interrupt politely in dialogues?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. work with peers to listen to a recording of an interview panel on the theme,

2. identify vocabulary used in the interview,

3. work in partnership with peers to find out the meaning of the new words identified,

4. conduct a mock interview with peers on a topic related to the theme,

5. apply turn-taking and interrupting politely in the mock interview,

6. review peers’ performance,

7. discuss with peers on effects of poor turn-taking or interruption modes in an interview, 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. work with peers to listen to a recording of an interview panel on the theme,
2. identify vocabulary used in the interview,
3. work in partnership with peers to find out the meaning of the new words identified,
4. conduct a mock interview with peers on a topic related to the theme,
5. apply turn-taking and interrupting politely in the mock interview,
6. review peers’ performance,
7. discuss with peers on effects of poor turn-taking or interruption modes in an interview, 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Self-expression – interviews together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: The learner interacts with digital content when listening to a recording of an interview panel on the theme.

• Learning to Learn: The learner discusses with peers on effects of poor turn-taking or interruption modes in an interview.

Values:
• Social Justice: The learner accords each one equal opportunities when applying turn-taking and interrupting politely in the

mock interview.

• Respect: This is developed as the learner ensures positive regard for others when peer reviewing other’s performance.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Peace Education: This is promoted as the learner studies turn- taking skills and interrupting politely during group conversations

for peaceful co-existence.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept of tolerance during turn-taking and interrupting politely, to the concept of application of

tolerance and kindness in speech in Religious Education.
